messages:
mina (eng-ml): quick note from today's bring-up for sirocco7b-2026-06. ran targeted int8 vs int6 experiments on production-sampled routes. need a short rec for GTN defaults and canary thresholds.
ravi (ml): drop the concise scorecard pls.
mina (eng-ml): paste summary from ~4k smoke requests + eval slices:
```
model: sirocco7b-2026-06
variants: int8, int6
latency p50/p95 (ms): int8 36/88, int6 39/105
throughput (tokens/sec): int8 240, int6 280
quality (EM on eval / avg F1 on QA slice): int8 88.9 / 0.86, int6 88.3 / 0.84
cost per 1k tokens est: int8 $0.0011, int6 $0.00072
notes: int6 cuts token cost ~34% vs int8; small average quality drop but concentrated on very long context instruction-follow (~1.2 EM) and a prompt-priming fragile slice we call "policy-templates" (~1.5 EM).
```
anya (ml): thanks. anything alarming on latency tail?
mina (eng-ml): p95 increases modest overall (~+17ms) but on policy-templates p95 spikes ~+120ms due to attention kernel behavior on long prompts. We saw no increase in error rates.
jade (prod): product ask: can we safely make int6 the GTN default for new tenants?
ravi (ml): recommendation: default->int8 for new tenants; enable int6 as "standard-eco" for chat/FAQ routes. For sensitive routes (policy/legal/finance), pin int8.
mina (eng-ml): rollout plan I propose:
- Canary: 24h at 20% traffic (stratified across slices)
- Probes: 120 chat prompts, 80 long-instr, 40 policy-template checks; cadence 5m
- Auto-fallback: if any probe category shows >1.0 EM drop sustained 15m OR p95 latency increase >50% sustained 15m => rollback to int8 for that route
- Monitoring: surface token-econ delta + per-route quality in console experiment panel
- UX: expose per-route "quality-tier" with choices: fidelity (int8), balanced (int8 opt-in), eco (int6 opt-in)
- Opt-in: make eco opt-in for managed GTN tenants; for self-serve, default to int8 until canary passes
deploy-bot: canary created id=c-4975, start=2026-06-10T11:00:00Z, traffic=20%, fallback=int8, alert-channel=#eng-ml-ops
jade (prod): add human-in-the-loop review for policy-template samples every 2h during canary. also draft customer advisory that clearly lists tasks where eco is not recommended.
anya (ml): I'll own the probe sets + realtime delta dashboard. Also recommend adding a tiny synthetic prompt set that stresses attention on long templates to catch kernel regressions.
ravi (ml): one engineering follow-up: try prefix-KV warmstart for policy-templates to see if p95 tail mitigates; if so, we can consider hybrid routing (start int6 then warmstart to int8 for later tokens) but we need simulation first.
mina (eng-ml): decision: run canary per bot. If 24h snapshot shows no sustained probe failures, propose switching GTN new-tenant default to int6 for chat-first templates but keep int8 as standard in product docs. I'll write up the rollout checklist and share.
jade (prod): thanks team. please tag #gtn when the advisory draft is ready.
mina (eng-ml): closing thread  will follow up with canary results and replay sim notes.
